name: Disagreement
overview: Scripture acknowledges that disagreements among believers are inevitable, as seen in the dispute between Paul and Barnabas (Acts 15:2). However, the Bible instructs Christians to address offenses privately and seek reconciliation (Matthew 18:15) while exercising righteous judgment rather than superficial evaluation (John 7:24). Above all, believers are commanded to love one another (John 15:17) and to receive those weak in faith without engaging in contentious arguments (Romans 14:1), walking in a manner worthy of their calling in the Lord (Ephesians 4:1).
